description: An authenticated bureau callback or poll may advance production status or report a terminal failure, but cannot rewind progress or change a terminal document. A repeated mapped status preserves existing metadata and timestamp, except that nonblank metadata may fill an empty field.
ignored_result: Return the unchanged, tenant-bound job as an idempotent accepted callback, except for the permitted same-rank metadata fill.
same_rank_metadata: A repeated mapped status may fill a blank tracking_number or error_message from a nonblank incoming value. It must not clear or replace a nonblank value. If neither field is filled, updated_at is unchanged.
